title: browse_web
description: Browse and extract content from web pages. Supports single or batch URL fetching with security-hardened SSRF prevention, content extraction (HTML/JSON/text), robots.txt compliance, rate limiting, and caching. Returns extracted text, metadata, and security audit info.

url.description: Single URL to fetch and extract content from (e.g., 'https://example.com/page'). Use either 'url' or 'urls', not both.

urls.description: Multiple URLs to fetch in batch (max 20). Use either 'url' or 'urls', not both.

search_query.description: Run a web search query and fetch result pages using configured engines.

search_engines.description: Optional list of search engines to use with search_query.

follow_redirects.description: Whether to follow HTTP redirects. Each redirect is security-validated. Default: true.

max_redirects.description: Maximum number of redirect hops to follow. Default: 5.

include_raw_html.description: Include raw HTML in the response for re-parsing. Default: false.

respect_robots_txt.description: Check robots.txt before fetching. Default: true.

use_cache.description: Use response cache to avoid re-fetching recently visited URLs. Default: true.

verify_ssl.description: Verify SSL/TLS certificates. Default: true. Setting false is blocked unless AI_AGENT_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS=true is explicitly set for local debugging.

custom_headers.description: Optional request headers. Only safe allowlisted headers are accepted at runtime.

compliance_action.description: Run a compliance/retention/incident action instead of fetching URLs.

target_domain.description: Target domain for compliance_action=purge_cache_domain or acknowledge_incident.
